notes: These are coordinator-authored benchmark claims, not quotations or endorsements of medical statements.

Evidence scopes are preparation instructions, NOT model-facing evidence packets. They deliberately expose limitations to the packager; do not feed these scopes or oracle rationale to evaluated models.
Final source verification, existing-benchmark overlap checks and taxonomy adjudication must precede gold freeze.
Newly authored claims do not establish absence from model pretraining; that is UNKNOWN.
Replace authoring IDs with opaque shuffled IDs before model presentation; keep oracle metadata separately.

candidates.source_title: Once-Weekly Semaglutide in Adults with Overweight or Obesity
candidates.authored_claim: In STEP 1, adults meeting the trial criteria for overweight or obesity, without diabetes, lost more weight over 68 weeks with weekly semaglutide plus lifestyle intervention than with placebo plus lifestyle intervention.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Use the primary abstract: randomized double-blind trial, 1961 adults, BMI eligibility and diabetes exclusion, 2.4 mg weekly, 68 weeks, mean weight change -14.9% versus -2.4%. Retain the difference between group means and individual outcomes.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Claim preserves intervention, comparator, enrolled population and measured outcome.

candidates.source_title: Adherence to a Mediterranean Diet and Survival in a Greek Population
candidates.authored_claim: Among the Greek adults in this prospective cohort, higher Mediterranean-diet scores were associated with lower all-cause mortality during the reported follow-up.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Use the primary abstract: 22043 adults, food-frequency questionnaire, observational prospective design, median 44 months, adjusted mortality association and uncertainty. Preserve association wording and cohort scope.
candidates.oracle_rationale: A bounded observational association can be solid; the study design alone must not force CvC.

candidates.source_title: Dexamethasone in Hospitalized Patients with Covid-19
candidates.authored_claim: In RECOVERY, dexamethasone reduced 28-day mortality in hospitalized COVID-19 patients receiving respiratory support at randomization; the trial did not demonstrate that benefit in the subgroup receiving no respiratory support.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package the randomized comparison and the complete 28-day mortality results by respiratory-support subgroup. Preserve the distinction between a subgroup with no demonstrated benefit and proof of no possible benefit. Verify wording against the final report, not an early press release.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Qualified subgroup-specific conclusion; adjudicator must check the negative clause does not assert equivalence.

candidates.source_title: Dapagliflozin in Patients with Heart Failure and Reduced Ejection Fraction
candidates.authored_claim: Among participants with symptomatic heart failure and reduced ejection fraction in DAPA-HF, adding dapagliflozin to recommended care lowered the risk of the trial composite of worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death compared with placebo.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package randomized trial, symptomatic HFrEF with ejection fraction at most 40%, background care, dapagliflozin versus placebo, exact composite definition and primary result. Preserve worsening heart failure and cardiovascular death as a composite.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Supported trial-specific composite-outcome statement, not a claim that every component improved equally.

candidates.source_title: A Clinical Trial of the Effects of Dietary Patterns on Blood Pressure
candidates.authored_claim: In the eight-week DASH feeding trial, the combination diet lowered average systolic blood pressure more than the control diet while sodium intake and body weight were held constant.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Use primary abstract: 459 adults, three-week run-in, eight-week randomized feeding phase, sodium and weight held constant, combination diet versus control, 5.5 mm Hg greater systolic reduction. Do not attribute this randomized effect to weight loss.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Accurate outcome and experimental-control statement.

candidates.source_title: NAD+ repletion improves mitochondrial and stem cell function and enhances life span in mice
candidates.authored_claim: In the reported mouse experiments, nicotinamide riboside treatment improved aged muscle stem-cell function and increased mouse lifespan.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Use the primary abstract and verify the relevant mouse results: NR, mitochondrial unfolded protein response, prohibitin proteins, aged muscle stem cells and mouse lifespan. Keep separate experimental endpoints separate; do not add a human treatment conclusion.
candidates.oracle_rationale: A bounded preclinical result can be solid; documented mechanism is not itself a mechanism-versus-evidence error.

candidates.source_title: Semaglutide and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Obesity without Diabetes
candidates.authored_claim: SELECT establishes cardiovascular prevention with semaglutide for adults with overweight who have never had cardiovascular disease.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package randomized SELECT design, age and BMI eligibility, requirement for established cardiovascular disease, diabetes exclusion, intervention and primary composite endpoint with result.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Extends secondary-prevention evidence to a population without established cardiovascular disease. No mechanism claim or observational causal inference is needed.

candidates.source_title: Vitamin D Supplements and Prevention of Cancer and Cardiovascular Disease
candidates.authored_claim: VITAL proves that vitamin D supplementation has no clinical benefit at any dose in adults.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package randomized trial population, vitamin D3 2000 IU/day, median 5.3-year intervention, invasive-cancer and major-cardiovascular-event estimates with confidence intervals. Include the actual null-result language, not a statement of universal ineffectiveness.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Unsupported negative generalization across doses, populations and outcomes. Null significance is not an equivalence result.

candidates.source_title: Effects of tranexamic acid on death, vascular occlusive events, and blood transfusion in trauma patients with significant haemorrhage (CRASH-2)
candidates.authored_claim: CRASH-2 supports the same mortality benefit from tranexamic acid when treatment begins more than eight hours after a traumatic injury.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package randomized CRASH-2 design and eligibility: adults with or at risk of significant hemorrhage, enrolled within eight hours of injury. Include the original mortality endpoint and result. Do not add later timing analyses to this single-source packet.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Extrapolates treatment timing beyond the enrolled window. The claim is about what this source supports, not all subsequent evidence.

candidates.source_title: Pembrolizumab versus Chemotherapy for PD-L1-Positive Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer
candidates.authored_claim: KEYNOTE-024 establishes the same survival advantage for pembrolizumab over chemotherapy in advanced non-small-cell lung cancer regardless of tumor PD-L1 expression.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package primary study eligibility and result, retaining PD-L1 expression on at least 50% of tumor cells and other eligibility restrictions. The accessed primary abstract conclusion reports longer progression-free and overall survival in that selected population.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Expands a biomarker-selected population to patients regardless of the biomarker.

candidates.source_title: A Randomized Trial of Albumin Infusions in Hospitalized Patients with Cirrhosis
candidates.authored_claim: ATTIRE establishes that targeting serum albumin of at least 30 g/L prevents the combined outcome of infection, kidney dysfunction or death in hospitalized patients with decompensated cirrhosis.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package randomized ATTIRE comparison, eligibility, albumin target, exact composite and primary estimate with CI. The retrieved primary-result excerpt reports 29.7% versus 30.2%; verify the complete primary analysis before freeze. Do not use mechanistic background paragraphs as the outcome evidence.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Claims established clinical benefit despite the reported randomized primary outcome not demonstrating it; adjudicate against the complete estimate.

candidates.source_title: Effect of Vitamin E and Memantine on Functional Decline in Alzheimer Disease: The TEAM-AD VA Cooperative Randomized Trial
candidates.authored_claim: TEAM-AD establishes that vitamin E prevents Alzheimer disease in cognitively healthy adults.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package the trial in mild-to-moderate established Alzheimer disease, alpha tocopherol versus placebo, ADCS-ADL functional decline and reported benefit. Preserve the difference between slowing functional decline in patients and preventing disease onset.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Both population and endpoint are expanded from treatment of established disease to primary prevention.

candidates.source_title: Association of Coffee Drinking With Mortality by Genetic Variation in Caffeine Metabolism
candidates.authored_claim: The UK Biobank coffee analysis shows that starting to drink coffee causes a reduction in a person's risk of death.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package the observational analysis of 498134 UK Biobank participants, baseline reported coffee intake, follow-up and adjusted mortality association. Include the fact that coffee intake was observed rather than assigned; omit general review-style mechanistic speculation.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Converts an observational exposure association to an intervention-causal claim.

candidates.source_title: Association of Nut Consumption with Total and Cause-Specific Mortality
candidates.authored_claim: The Nurses' Health Study and Health Professionals Follow-up Study analysis establishes that increasing nut consumption itself prevents premature death.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package these two observational cohorts, repeated dietary questionnaires, follow-up and adjusted mortality association. Keep this study family distinct from dietary-intervention trials mentioned in its introduction.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Asserts causality from an observational analysis; cited randomized studies in the introduction are not this study's design.

candidates.source_title: Association Between Ultraprocessed Food Consumption and Risk of Mortality Among Middle-aged Adults in France
candidates.authored_claim: The NutriNet-Sante mortality analysis establishes that reducing ultraprocessed food intake would lower mortality in otherwise unchanged participants.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package the prospective observational French cohort, dietary-record exposure measurement, age eligibility, follow-up and adjusted mortality association. Do not introduce a dietary intervention that was not performed.
candidates.oracle_rationale: A counterfactual intervention conclusion exceeds the observational design.

candidates.source_title: Association Between Screen Time and Children's Performance on a Developmental Screening Test
candidates.authored_claim: Because screen time was measured before later developmental scores, the All Our Families analysis proves that screen exposure causes developmental impairment.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package the prospective cohort of 2441 children, parent-reported screen time, ASQ-3 screening at 24, 36 and 60 months, cross-lagged analysis and reported associations. Preserve screening-test performance rather than converting it into a clinical diagnosis.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Temporal ordering and a cross-lagged model do not alone identify the claimed causal effect; boundary/adversarial item.

candidates.source_title: Association of estimated sleep duration and naps with mortality and cardiovascular events: a study of 116632 people from 21 countries
candidates.authored_claim: PURE establishes that shortening long sleepers' sleep to the reference duration would reduce their risk of death or a major cardiovascular event.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package the prospective PURE cohort, self-reported estimated sleep duration, observed reference category, follow-up and adjusted association with the composite outcome. Do not relabel self-selected sleep duration as randomized treatment.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Turns a sleep-duration association into a prescription-level causal counterfactual.

candidates.source_title: Effect of exposure to natural environment on health inequalities: an observational population study
candidates.authored_claim: The England green-space study establishes that adding green space to deprived neighborhoods would cause their mortality inequality to shrink.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package observational population classification by deprivation and green-space exposure, mortality records from 2001-2005, stratified adjusted models and the lower inequality observed in greener areas. The title word Effect must not substitute for study design.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Causal interpretation of an observational area-level comparison; adversarial title cue.

candidates.source_title: Resveratrol improves health and survival of mice on a high-calorie diet
candidates.authored_claim: The metabolic pathway effects in this resveratrol study establish that resveratrol supplements extend the lives of people eating a high-calorie diet.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Retrieve the primary mouse study and package the actually measured metabolic-pathway results, animal population, intervention and survival outcome. A documented mechanism must be present; do not infer a mechanism solely from the supplement name or the title. Source identity and detailed mechanism remain to be rechecked.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Uses preclinical mechanistic and animal results as demonstrated human longevity benefit.

candidates.source_title: The Achilles' heel of senescent cells: from transcriptome to senolytic drugs
candidates.authored_claim: Selective killing of senescent cells in this study establishes that dasatinib plus quercetin prevents age-related disability in older adults.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package the study's anti-apoptotic/pro-survival targeting rationale, cell experiments and murine functional outcomes. Retain the distinction between human cells and treatment of human participants. Verify the exact combined-drug results in the primary paper.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Documented cellular mechanism plus preclinical outcomes are promoted to established patient benefit.

candidates.source_title: Metformin Retards Aging in C. elegans by Altering Microbial Folate and Methionine Metabolism
candidates.authored_claim: By changing microbial folate and methionine metabolism, metformin has been shown in this study to extend human lifespan.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package C. elegans and cocultured E. coli experiments, the microbial-metabolism mechanism and worm lifespan findings. Include organism and culture conditions; do not merge this source with human diabetes trials.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Explicit mechanism-to-human-longevity inference from a worm-microbe system.

candidates.source_title: Induction of autophagy by spermidine promotes longevity
candidates.authored_claim: The autophagy mechanism in this spermidine study demonstrates that taking spermidine extends human life.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Use the primary abstract: yeast, flies, worms and human immune cells; histone acetylation changes and autophagy; enhanced autophagy required for the experimental longevity effect. Human immune-cell survival is not a human lifespan endpoint.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Promotes a mechanistic experimental finding and cell/organism longevity to an established human lifespan benefit.

candidates.source_title: Activation of Transcription Factor NF-kappaB Is Suppressed by Curcumin (Diferuloylmethane)
candidates.authored_claim: Curcumin's suppression of NF-kappaB in this experiment establishes that oral curcumin treats inflammatory disease in patients.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package the ML-1a cell-line experiments, activators, NF-kappaB signaling readouts and the reported inhibition step. Do not describe cultured human leukemia cells as a clinical trial or provide an invented patient outcome.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Molecular-pathway inhibition is used as sufficient evidence of clinical efficacy.

candidates.source_title: A receptor for green tea polyphenol EGCG
candidates.authored_claim: The 67-kDa laminin receptor mechanism establishes that drinking green tea treats cancer in patients.
candidates.evidence_scope_to_package: Package receptor-expression experiments in cancer cells and EGCG binding measured by surface plasmon resonance. Retrieve and verify the original primary abstract/full text before freeze. Preserve the difference between the isolated compound, drinking tea and clinical cancer outcomes.
candidates.oracle_rationale: Promotes documented receptor-level activity to a treatment claim in people.

variants.authored_claim: STEP 1 participants without diabetes who met its overweight or obesity criteria had greater average weight loss at 68 weeks with semaglutide plus lifestyle intervention than with placebo plus lifestyle intervention.
With body weight and sodium intake kept constant, the DASH combination diet produced a larger mean systolic blood-pressure reduction than the control diet over eight weeks.
Adults with overweight but no established cardiovascular disease can expect the cardiovascular protection established by SELECT.
The VITAL findings rule out clinical benefits from vitamin D supplements across adult populations and dosing regimens.
The screen-time analysis identifies a causal impairment of development, since higher screen exposure preceded the later developmental screening scores.
Creating greener neighborhoods would causally narrow deprivation-related mortality differences, as established by the England green-space analysis.
This experiment demonstrates human lifespan extension from metformin through its effects on microbial folate and methionine metabolism.
Autophagy activation in the spermidine experiments establishes that spermidine supplementation prolongs people's lives.
